items.title: Award: BCU-DCO-63769 - ENDOSCOPY SCOPES AND STACKS - PHASE 2 INC. DRYING CABINET
items.summary: NHS Wales Shared Services Partnership-Procurement Services (hosted by Velindre University NHS Trust). Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board have direct awarded a contract for the purchase of Endoscopy scopes and stacks.

items.title: Hepatitis A infections identified in Newcastle primary schools
items.summary: Two hepatitis A cases have been identified at primary schools in Newcastle, officials from the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) have confirmed.
